text: Costa Crociere S.p.A. owns and operates the Costa and AIDA cruise brands and is the principal operating subsidiary of Carnival plc (part of Carnival Corporation & plc), which lists a 99.9% ownership interest in it in the group's 2025 annual report.
short: Costa Crociere is a subsidiary of Carnival plc (Carnival Corporation & plc)

source.name: Carnival plc: Annual Report Year Ended November 30, 2025 (PDF, pp. 115 and 117)
source.quote: the Parent Company’s principal operating subsidiary was Costa Crociere S.p.A. (“Costa Crociere”), which owns and operates the Costa and AIDA cruise brands.
source.note: The report's list of the Parent Company's undertakings (financial statements, p. 117) states 'Costa Crociere S.p.A. 99.9%'.
